summary: TomTom is dutch manufacturer of automotive navigation systems, founded in 1991. About 4,500 employees (Wikidata). Revenue $701 million (2019). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 4 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about growth or hiring.

culture.text: Dutch company known for maps and navigation, now selling location technology to carmakers and businesses.

open.text: TomTom International B.V., TomTom Global Content B.V. and TomTom Navigation B.V. are IND recognised visa sponsors.

growth.text: Had about 4,500 employees and $701 million revenue in 2019.
Won new deals, including traffic data for French motorway operator Cofiroute and Orbis Maps for Cedar Electronics.

worth_knowing.text: After 35 years TomTom has moved from classic GPS devices to guiding self-driving cars.
Deepened its partnership with Microsoft, bringing its location data to Microsoft Fabric and AI agents.
